phase3_findings.description: The 'normalizer could not be sourced' fail-closed arm of scripts/stop-refresher.sh (the [ -r "$_reap_lib" ] guard fails, _reap_base="" -> REAP_GLOB="") is never exercised by any test; the drive-letter no-converter arm (AC6b) still successfully sources normalize-path.sh. phase3_findings.description: The forward-slash drive-letter fail-closed alternative [A-Za-z]:/* in the reap-scope case is not distinctly exercised: both tested fail-closed inputs (UNC \\server\share, drive-letter D:\a\_work) match the *\\* backslash catch-all, so deleting or breaking the [A-Za-z]:/* character class would leave the suite green. A stubbed converter emitting a C:/... value would close it.
phase3_findings.step25_classification: suspected over-grade: shape 3 (uncorroborated single-source from pr-test-analyzer, no Phase-2 FAIL) — advisory only; below critical threshold, drives no REJECT

phase3_findings.description: The empty-base case arm (REAP_GLOB="") is reachable only via the untested source-failure branch; folding a no-signalling assertion into the source-failure test discharges both.

The _stop_sh_guarded default-path mirror in lib/test/run.sh hand-copies stop-refresher.sh's default pidfile/log/reap-glob formulas with no pin coupling the two, so a future change to the helper's defaults would leave the containment guard validating stale paths while still reporting green (fail-open where it claims fail-closed). The coupling is documented in-comment but unpinned.
phase3_findings.step25_classification: not flagged (Suggestion; below threshold; corroborated N=2)

phase3_findings.description: The AC5 MSYS textual-rules arm asserts only the negative (fail-closed breadcrumb absent) and exit 0; it does not place/reap an orphan under the MSYS-converted path, so it confirms 'not fail-closed' without confirming the conversion resolved to a usable root (weaker than the wslpath/cygpath AC8 arm). It also escapes region containment by design (harmless: /c/msysroot does not exist on CI).
phase3_findings.step25_classification: not flagged (Suggestion; below threshold; corroborated N=2)

phase3_findings.description: A drive-relative Windows form (C:foo, no separator after the colon) passes normalize-path.sh's ^[A-Za-z]:[\\/] regex through unchanged, then misses both fail-closed case arms and falls to the *) arm, yielding a relative glob C:foo/devflow-refresh-*.pid that matches nothing with no breadcrumb — the 'reaps nothing silently' shape the fix targets. Unreachable operationally (RUNNER_TEMP is always absolute).
phase3_findings.step25_classification: suspected over-grade: shape 1 (fail-closed/no-op fail-direction; unreachable operationally) — advisory; below threshold

phase3_findings.description: Reap-skip breadcrumbs are plain echo, not ::warning::, so a native-Windows self-hosted host that cannot normalize RUNNER_TEMP leaves orphaned refreshers un-reaped with no job-UI signal. Correct fail-safe direction; surfacing-visibility suggestion only.
